answer: Cross-cluster duels: each answer plays 6 pairwise duels where a juror picks the stronger of two texts, and only wins over rivals from a different funding cluster count toward rank. A ring of 50 accounts duelling itself earns 0 counted wins, so it cannot forge rank. Same-cluster wins are timber: bulky but worthless. Bypass: buying outside rivals costs about 6 x 50 = 300 side deals per epoch, and unless all are bought the win rate falls toward 50 percent. Check rule: anyone recounts duels from the ledger, drops same-cluster pairs; a nebula of near ties (45 to 55 percent) pays nothing.
